text:
paul: Heads upOrionCloud just escalatedthree racks delayed at customs. asking for either (a) 10-day reservation push or (b) reduce their insurance hold window. need decision today.

maria: which reservations and which customer pools are impacted?

paul: refs: RSRV-9771, RSRV-9772, RSRV-9773. two Dedicated customer pools, low load this week but scheduled scale in 910 days.

sunita: ops POV we can cover 304 days with buffer, 7 days is tight but workable if partner covers expedited freight or we route a spare rack. 10 days starts to risk SLA for some customers.

james: legal won't drop the insurance clause. we need written attestation that coverage remains for all shipments.

paul: @orion-partner can you confirm insurance stays in place? and can you prepay for expedited freight if needed?

orion-partner: sorry for the scramble port paperwork and a customs rep pulled manifest. insurance remains active. we can prepay expedited for two racks now, third rack needs an extra 4 days to clear. can we do a 7-day grace?

elaine: finance estimate: expedited freight delta ~ $7.2k. if partner prepays 50% now, we can absorb remainder and reconcile later. need sales approval for billing pass-through.

maria: recommendation: offer a one-time 7-day extension conditioned on: (1) partner submits insurance confirmation; (2) partner prepays 50% of expedited freight within 18h; (3) partner posts revised ETDs within 48h. include auto-fallback clause.

sunita: add ops requirement: if manifest not on-truck by day 7 we trigger auto-routing to model-variant pools and throttle ramping customers until native capacity returns. I'll add runbook steps and a ticket.

james: legal: ok to approve that amendment. send me exact wording and I'll produce a short amendment doc.

paul: draft amendment to send: ```Amendment: Redwood will grant a one-time 7-day capacity extension for RSRV-9771/72/73 subject to: partner maintains cargo insurance; partner prepays 50% of expedited freight costs within 18 hours; partner provides revised ETD within 48 hours. Failure to meet these conditions authorizes Redwood to execute fallback routing and invoice partner for any incremental costs.```

orion-partner: confirmed we will upload insurance docs and prepay 50% within 12h. rack-3 ETD is +4 days. appreciate the help.

ops-bot: created PARTNERS-4021 provision marketplace buffer rack -> SFO-3, update reservations, notify customers. owner: sunita. due: 12h.

paul: next steps: james to issue amendment, elaine to send payment link, sunita to provision buffer, maria to update marketplace notes. I'll coordinate partner comms. :thumbsup:
